IC1: 1. Is equal to or greater than 18 years of age.
IC2: 2. Histologic [OR] or cytologic confirmation of advanced refractory solid tumors with [NOT] no standard treatment options, including some patients with advanced disease in reduced general condition (Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) 3 and 4).
IC3: 3. Patients with measurable [OR] or evaluable disease per Response Evaluation Criteria In Solid Tumors (RECIST) version 1.1.
IC4: 4. Patients must be able to provide blood samples [OR] or tissue samples for NGS (Next Generation Sequencing) testing. The amount of blood [OR] and tissue samples should be able to meet the requirements of DNA extraction and quality control.
IC6: 6. Patients could receive treatment program from MTB (Molecular Tumor Board).
IC7: 7. Ability to understand and the willingness to provide a written informed consent document.
